name: Vancity enviro Visa Infinite Privilege Card

localized_names.en: Vancity enviro Visa Infinite Privilege Card

credit_required.notes: At least 19 with a BC address, and one of $150,000 personal income, $200,000 household income, $50,000 annual card spend, or $400,000 in investable funds.

base_rate.description: 1.5 points per $1 on all other purchases.

rewards.redemption_notes: Vancity Rewards points redeem for cash back, travel, charitable donations and gift cards; cash back requires a Vancity deposit account.

benefits.title: Airport lounge passes
benefits.description: Six complimentary airport lounge visits a year for each cardholder on the account.

notes: Network tier is Visa Infinite Privilege per the card name.
